notes.title: May 2023: Questions & Answers
notes.notes:
[b]Q: Can you provide some clarification on the settings and features available in the game?[/b]
A: Sure! Regarding the settings, general and accessibility settings were always on the roadmap but unfortunately, we were unable to package them for the launch. However, we are working to address this in a future update. Currently, players can navigate between the main menu and puzzle screens, as well as toggle full-screen mode.

[b]Q: What is free mode in the game?[/b]
A: Free mode is a block of randomly selected puzzles that players can solve with no cookie restrictions applied to undos, restarts, or skips. We plan to further augment this mode by allowing players to shift through tracks from the OST to play as they solve puzzles.  It's unlocked by completing all the story mode chapters OR by entering the <SECRET CODE> on the main menu [i]twice[/i].

Additionally, we want to let you know that we have a content/update roadmap pending which will include accessibility settings, content, and even a new mode that we are excited to share with you soon. 
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Parrots @ MIX
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919370/7cc338330fce9610e76f78c305a37d55f8a38cf4.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to share some exciting news from our time at the onsite MIX event during GDC 2023. We had the opportunity to showcase our game, "On the Peril of Parrots", and it was an amazing experience getting to share our game with fellow developers and gamers alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919370/03b75bc5edfb75345aeac7cbbd4322d41c8124b9.jpg[/img]

Not only did we get real-time feedback on our game, but we also had the chance to check out some other awesome projects on display at the event. It was great to see so many talented developers coming together and sharing their work.

Thanks again to everyone who stopped by to check out "On the Peril of Parrots" - we're thrilled to have been a part of such a fantastic event.
